Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: A rural-urban digital divide persists. Morocco has a 2018-2023 plan to expand internet network and coverage in rural areas. Digital Morocco 2030 strategy explicitly targets reducing digital divide. Morocco's large rural population still faces connectivity and accessibility gaps. Score 2: partial rural coverage with active improvement programs.
redteam_note: Source is a dev/aggregator/off-topic domain — check it actually supports the score.
revision_notes: Updated with fresher, authoritative data. ANRT's own 2024/2025 household survey shows internet access at roughly 89% (urban) vs 66% (rural), and government figures reported in late 2024/2025 show 99% rural 2G/3G/4G network coverage (10,660 of 10,740 planned rural localities), with a second phase targeting the remaining underserved areas by 2026. Network coverage is now near-universal but a real usage/adoption gap persists, so score 2 (Partial rural coverage) is confirmed, though the gap is narrowing and this may soon merit re-rating to 3.
